- M4-notes.md lines 850–851: "The reference blades' hand-off takes ≤ 0.021 ms but the saw's 0.254".

M1 bit-identity, by reading: the tree's root is (1, n). keptFor descends only through d > tol, and tol ≥ 0.004 > 0, so d > tol implies dmax ≥ 0, hence imax > a and children exist. So keptFor visits exactly the segments the iterative Douglas–Peucker visits, with the same (imax, dmax), from the same unchanged loop over the same us/vs. The tree is finite on any input: each child is strictly shorter, so there are at most about 2n nodes.
